Independent squared-headway reward derivation and 22 small phase/boundary recurrence diagnostics
correctness.rationale: With T normalized to 1 and s=p+q−r, a next-opportunity recurrence gives the residual from the indexed cut after B_n as V=(1−px)/s. At x=1 that cut is before A_{n+1}, whose elapsed time is zero; a passenger arriving at the coincident instant has measure zero. Independently, between consecutive nonempty cycles the cross-cycle headway is G+F′−L, with G geometric on {1,2,…} of parameter s, F′ the next first offset and L the current last offset. The two nonempty-cycle marks are independent of each other and G; F′ equals x with probability (q−r)/s and L equals x with probability q/s. Within a nonempty cycle one adds a gap square x² with probability r/s. The mean uniform forward wait is s/2 times the total mean squared-gap reward per nonempty cycle. Using E G=1/s and E G²=(2−s)/s² gives the stated (2pq x²−2rx+2−s)/(2s). Zero-length gaps are harmless at both endpoints and the labels do not change, so both endpoints are covered by this derivation too. The curvature 2pq/s is positive, and r≥0, giving the unique projected minimizer min{1,r/(2pq)}, even at the transition equalities. For p=q=r=2/5 substitution confirms 7/5 versus 8/5 in normalized units.
residual_risks: The frozen rational-grid/simulation diagnostics do not certify the full continuum. The formula uses time-uniform arrivals, independent labeled cycle pairs, and a joint within-pair law held fixed as x varies.

value.rationale: The model isolates a design effect not captured by reliability marginals: holding p and q fixed, co-failure dependence changes the optimal offset and can make coincidence optimal at either end under different labels. At p=q=2/5, for example, the feasible r range includes zero, independence, and the clipped endpoint regime. The exact formula shows why equal spacing is not a universal rule even when frequencies are fixed, and provides a usable benchmark for any fixed feasible p,q,r.
residual_risks: This is a stylized scheduling benchmark, not an empirical estimate or a recommendation under delays, capacity limits, or phase-dependent physical failure correlations.
